description: This file contains utility functions for parsing and processing OpenAPI specifications, including extracting provider options, setting parameter types and options, processing parameters, and converting OpenAPI schemas into widget-compatible data structures. It facilitates dynamic generation of widget schemas and data columns based on OpenAPI definitions.

methods.name: list[str] extract_providers(params: list[dict])
methods.description: Extracts list of provider options from given API parameters.

methods.name: set_parameter_type(p: dict, p_schema: dict)
methods.description: Determines and sets the parameter type in schema based on the schema definitions and parameter name conventions.

methods.name: dict set_parameter_options( p: dict, p_schema: dict, providers: list[str] )
methods.description: Sets options for a parameter based on its schema, including choices, widget configs, and provider-specific options.

methods.name: dict process_parameter(param: dict, providers: list[str])
methods.description: Processes a single parameter object, resolving provider-specific choices, types, labels, and other metadata to generate a widget-compatible parameter schema.

methods.name: tuple[list[dict],bool] get_query_schema_for_widget( openapi_json: dict, command_route: str )
methods.description: Extracts and prepares the query parameters schema for a specific widget route in the OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: get_data_schema_for_widget(openapi_json, operation_id, route: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the data response schema associated with a widget operation from the OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: data_schema_to_columns_defs( openapi_json, operation_id, provider, route: Optional[str] = None, get_widget_config: bool = False, )
methods.description: Converts a data schema obtained from OpenAPI into a list of column definitions suitable for display, with types and formatting.

methods.name: post_query_schema_for_widget( openapi_json, operation_id, route: Optional[str] = None, target_schema: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Prepares and extracts the POST request schema for a widget based on its operationId in the OpenAPI spec.

ctags.name: data_schema_to_columns_defs
ctags.signature: ( openapi_json, operation_id, provider, route: Optional[str] = None, get_widget_config: bool = False, )

ctags.name: post_query_schema_for_widget
ctags.signature: ( openapi_json, operation_id, route: Optional[str] = None, target_schema: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: set_parameter_options
ctags.signature: ( p: dict, p_schema: dict, providers: list[str] )
